notes: lambda_2 is NOT a flat constant -- it is derived per matrix from lambda_2_row_ref via the row-equivalent rescaling: D_raw = sliding_block_diff_matrix(N, block_size, normalize=False); f = ||D_raw||_2 / ||D_raw's row||; lambda_2 = f * lambda_2_row_ref (N = number of columns of the matrix being clustered). Uses the spectral-norm solver (norm_mode='spectral', the default), not the row-norm solver. See run_ssc_sparse_block_tv_rowscaled in icassp_ssc_tv2/final_code/sscbench/methods.py.
